name: Communication Matters
description: UK charity and ISAAC chapter supporting people who use Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC), their families and professionals, with information on AAC systems, assessment services, peer support and research.
intended_use: Find UK AAC information, assessment-service routes, community activity and user-led support.
audience_or_context: AAC users, people with little or no clear speech, families, communication partners and professionals across the UK.
limitations: AAC selection should be individual and may require specialist assessment; a general information page cannot choose a system for a person.
Provision and funding vary across UK nations, ages and local services.
cost_or_access_notes: Public information is available online; membership, conferences or training may have fees, while some AAC-user support is subsidised or free.
conflicts_of_interest: The charity represents and advocates for AAC users and the AAC field; it receives membership, event and grant income and is not an independent evaluator of every AAC product.

provenance.method: Current first-party identity, access route and stated function checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records what the resource is and how to reach it without adopting provider claims of benefit.
